THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
Declaration under Section 07

My No.: 3/6/2016/11. Land Ministry Reference No.: 4-37/2016/HW/156. I do hereby give notice under sub -section (i) Section 07 of land Acquisition Act , (chapter 460) as amended by No.58 of 1983, No. 29 of 1983 and No. 7 of 1979 . that the state intends to Acquire the following lands which require for a public purpose. Description of the land:- One hundred eighty four Lots (184), (01 – 184) in total extent of 18.1084 Hectares, as depicted preliminary No. ý 2359 of 27.12.2016 in the villages of Henepola,Kehelwatthena,Wegollemada and Wadakada in Grama Niladari Divisions No.886- Hiripathwella, No.888- Dewategedra, No. 956- Wadakada and No. 957-Ginneriya in Divisional Secretary’s Division of Polgahawela in Kurunegala District; North Western Province. Further described as follows:
